title: You can have the edge and still lose everything
hook: You can be right every time on average, and still lose everything.

scenes.say: You can be right every time on average, and still lose everything.
Risk of ruin isn't about losing once. It's about betting too much on once.
{players} players. A game they win {a_p} of the time. A real edge of {a_edge}.
Bet {a_stake} of your stack each time: {a_ruin} go broke.

scenes.big_label: wiped out — with the same edge

scenes.say: Lose half and you need double just to get back. The math of losses isn't symmetric.
